title: Midshift observability scrapbook - Harper
content:
Quick midshift scratchpad — not polished, just brain-dump and todo for follow-ups.

09:12 AM — booted console, noticed increased error rate on /v1/generate (region eu-west-1).
- spike visible on dashboard: requests p50 latency up from 120ms -> 420ms over last 18m.
- errors ~ 1.2% (mostly 503s) but customer-reported impact for AcmeCorp (ticket JIRA-INF-3421).

Immediate checks (done):
- k8s pod restarts? quick-kubectl: kubectl -n redwood get pods | grep generate -> 2 pods OOMKilled (oom scores look high).
- infra alerts: node pressure on accel-03-eu (cpu 88%, mem 94%).
- rolling restart on generate-deployment (scaled up by +2 replicas), temp mitigation.

Notes / hypotheses:
- KV cache eviction pattern might be thrashing with longer sequences; seeing many cold-cache misses (check cache-hit metrics).
- Possible kernel regression after last runtime bump (see PR #512).
- Autoscaler configured with conservative CPU thresholds in eu-west; might be slow to react to bursty inference.

Todo (prioritized):
1) Follow up on AcmeCorp ticket: summarize mitigation and ETA to fix — ping @samir. (JIRA-INF-3421)
2) Run exec to gather logs from oom pods: kubectl logs -p <pod> > /tmp/oom-generate-03.log — attach to ticket.
3) Check cache-hit-rate dashboard (panel: obs/cache/hit-rate-eu) and compare last 72h; look for correlation with latency.
4) Rollback runtime image to v1.14.2 on staging and run replay harness (prereq: notify bench infra). If stable, schedule controlled rollback for eu-west.
5) Open brief postmortem draft if errors persist > 30m. Collect traces for sample requests (trace ids pinned to slack thread).

Follow ups for later:
- Ask research for sequence-length distribution samples for AcmeCorp workload (suspect unusually long prompts).
- Discuss autoscaler tuning: move to target-based scaling on request queue size vs CPU.
- Add a temporary circuit-breaker in routing to divert to fallback model variant (cheaper, smaller context) if queue depth > X.

Misc scratch notes (random):
- Customer phone call at 11:30 — prep brief: what we did, what next, CI run times.
- Slack snippets to paste: "We're seeing transient 503s in eu-west; mitigation in progress; will follow up with root cause within 2 business days."
- Quick checklist for handoff -> night shift: what we changed (scaled +2 replicas), where logs saved (/tmp/oom-generate-03.log), ticket id, contact: samir@redwood.ai.

Unresolved questions I want to remember:
- Did the GPU driver update land on accel-03-eu two nights ago? Who merged? (check infra PR history)
- Are there any scheduled batch jobs that spike memory usage at ~08:50? Runbook mentions "embedding-reindex" at 03:00 only.

End of midshift notes. Keep this doc for a few cycles, will prune into a nicer incident summary if escalates.

-- Harper
(oncall, eng-observability)
